description: Ministry of Health - National Mental Health Policy of Sri Lanka 2020-2030
categorisation: This gazette content announces and publishes the National Mental Health Policy of Sri Lanka 2020-2030. While it mentions the Ministry of Health and its Secretary, it does not contain government structural changes, personnel appointments, or detailed portfolio assignments. The content focuses on health policy formulation and implementation guidelines, which falls under health sector announcements - a specialized administrative matter not covered by Types 1-9, making it appropriate for the Miscellaneous category.
